description: This PHP source file defines the `SaveEmployeeController` class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends an abstract controller to manage employee save operations, including generating new employee IDs and setting up Vue.js components with relevant properties for the frontend UI. It uses traits for social media authentication and interacts with entities such as Employee and EmpPicture, indicating its role in employee data handling.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling employee save operations in the HR management system, extending Vue.js component setup and managing employee ID generation and property configuration for the frontend.

methods.name: getIdGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the IDGeneratorService instance used for generating new employee IDs.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties such as employee ID, allowed image types, and password requirement status based on social media authentication settings.
